::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 8th	1870 [corrected from 1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95[^1]
:::

Miss Yonge begs to return her best thanks on behalf of [Bishop Patteson](people/person_1155.qmd) to [Mr Fielder](people/person_510.qmd) and his congregation for their Epiphany contribution to the [Melanesian Mission](organizations/other_30.qmd)

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
